verdictEs: Palworld Pal Editor si necesitas Docker/WebUI, server remoto o el Viewing Cage en multi. Palworld Save Pal si solo editas tu save local en Steam o Game Pass y quieres workflow rápido.
verdictEn: Palworld Pal Editor if you need Docker/WebUI, remote server access, or the Viewing Cage in multi. Palworld Save Pal if you only edit a local save on Steam or Game Pass and want a fast workflow.

useCases.labelEs: Editar save local de Steam single-player
useCases.labelEn: Edit a local Steam single-player save
useCases.reasonEs: Save Pal tiene UX desktop más pulida y workflow más rápido para edits casuales. Auto-detecta el save sin config y la GUI es más amigable que la WebUI de Pal Editor.
useCases.reasonEn: Save Pal has a more polished desktop UX and faster workflow for casual edits. Auto-detects the save without config and the GUI is friendlier than Pal Editor's WebUI.

useCases.labelEs: Editar saves de server dedicado remoto
useCases.reasonEs: Pal Editor tiene Docker container que corre en el server y expone WebUI accesible desde browser. Save Pal requiere acceso local al archivo, no aplica a setups remotos.
useCases.reasonEn: Pal Editor ships a Docker container that runs on the server and exposes a WebUI accessible from any browser. Save Pal requires local file access, doesn't apply to remote setups.

useCases.reasonEs: Solo Pal Editor expone la flag del save que habilita el Viewing Cage fuera de single-player. Save Pal no toca esa flag.
useCases.reasonEn: Only Pal Editor exposes the save flag that enables the Viewing Cage outside single-player. Save Pal doesn't touch that flag.

useCases.labelEs: Editar inventario y stats del player (no solo Pals)
useCases.labelEn: Edit player inventory and stats (not just Pals)
useCases.reasonEs: Save Pal tiene tabs dedicados a Player Inventory, Stats y Unlocks. Pal Editor está más enfocado en Pals individuales y deja el inventario del player como afterthought.
useCases.reasonEn: Save Pal has dedicated tabs for Player Inventory, Stats, and Unlocks. Pal Editor is more focused on individual Pals and treats player inventory as an afterthought.

useCases.reasonEs: Pal Editor tiene CLI scriptable (instalable via pip). Save Pal es 100% GUI sin equivalent CLI — no se puede meter en un cron job ni pipeline.
useCases.reasonEn: Pal Editor has a scriptable CLI (installable via pip). Save Pal is 100% GUI with no CLI equivalent — can't be wired into a cron job or pipeline.
